datasetVersion: eLife version of record 2 (published 2021-01-18, version date 2021-04-13); elife-62438-supp1-v2.xlsx (sheets LB 0.4, LB 2.0, M63 0.4) and elife-62438-supp3-v2.xlsx (sheet LB 0.4). score = Supplementary file 3 column 'intrinsic terminator score (intrinsic termination ≥ 3.0)'

notes: Records: 125 of 1794 merged Term-seq 3' ends. The 3110 per-condition rows of Supplementary file 1 (LB 0.4: 1175, LB 2.0: 882, M63: 1053) merge into 1794 ends when ends on the same strand within 10 nt are treated as one, the paper's rule, which reproduces its Figure 1-figure supplement 2B counts exactly. Kept: ends whose LB 0.4 intrinsic terminator score is >= 3.0 (111 not in a Rho termination region, 14 also in one; the paper's two calls are not exclusive). Dropped as not classified intrinsic: 56 ends the paper places only in a Rho termination region (they are not Rho peaks, so they are not in adams2021-rho-termination either); 433 scored ends with neither call, which the paper says are likely RNA processing sites (20 dropped scored ends have an undefined intrinsic score); and 1180 ends the paper never scored (all LB 2.0-only and M63-only ends, and LB 0.4 ends outside 5' UTRs and genes), which include mature tRNA 3' ends and other RNA processing sites. Position: the base reported by the most conditions, then the highest read count; terminationBp is that base (0-based). The score belongs to the LB 0.4 base, which differs from the record base in 10 records (by 1, 2, 4, 6 nt). score is the paper's intrinsic terminator score, not a read count. Record names give the paper's gene classes in plain words: after (primary, within 50 nt downstream of a gene's end), inside (internal), opposite (antisense), away from annotated genes (orphan). Not kept in records.json (reproducible from the build script): per-condition positions and read counts, gene lists, Rho scores at the end, regulatory element labels and upstream/internal ORF context. Never used: EcoCyc gene_id identifiers in the details columns, the 61-nt sequence column (used only to prove every position), Supplementary file 2 (see adams2021-rho-termination) and Supplementary file 4 (strains, oligos).
